volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

partials.tooltip: Partial count cap. Fractional values fade the top partial in (e.g. 3.5 = three partials plus the fourth at half level), so sweeps are smooth.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: Side to side. Trimorph: trisaw peak position (0.5 = triangle, toward 0.01 / 0.99 = saw / ramp). Square (PWM): pulse width. Band-limited at every setting (moves the offset DSF kernel).

blend.tooltip: SquSaw only: saw (0) to square (1), a crossfade of two band-limited waves from the same kernel. Other waveforms ignore it.

bright.tooltip: Harmonic tilt (DSF geometric rolloff): 0 = sine, 1 = the full bright wave. Band-limited at every setting. Nonlinear slider: more sensitivity near 0 (where most of the useful range is).

mode.tooltip: Free follows live Duration, Shape, and Amplitude. Latch captures them at each trigger.

decayTime.tooltip: Seconds from Trigger height to 0.001 (hyperbolic amp-shape).

shape.tooltip: Exp time warp on the hyperbolic curve. 0 = linear time.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Out = hyperbolic(Trigger height → 0.001) × Amplitude.

drive.tooltip: Input gain 0…4. Default 0.5. Noon 1.0 on the VCV panel is a 4t² curve; this slider is linear gain.

spread.tooltip: Stereo cutoff offset. Only when Left and Right are both wired.

seed.tooltip: Noise seed. Same Seed = same output; new modules get their own.

softenAttack.tooltip: 0…1 = Attack 0…0.02 s. KT (MIDI 0…127) unit-mods that span: −10% at 0, −41.25% at 127.

tail.tooltip: How long the pluck rings. Higher = longer. Inverted breadboard Dampen (0 = shortest, 2.2 = longest).

synthVsAcoustic.tooltip: DC offset on the inverted-env → expo → Release path. Higher = more acoustic linger.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: Latch: freeze Soften Attack on rising Trigger (release fold from Tail / Synth stays live). Free: knobs always live.

direction.tooltip: Forward / reverse speed. Adds to Speed: 0 no change, negative pushes toward reverse.

phase.tooltip: Fine scratch skip (−0.003…+0.003). 0.156 s Papoulis internal glide.

contrast.tooltip: Gamma on an 80 dB window after dBFS. 1 = linear dB. Turn up to lift quiet harmonics. 0 = mid grey. Negative inverts.

brightness.tooltip: Linear gain before the dB window. 1 = 0 dBFS at the top. 0 = black. Negative is the same gain, then invert.

minFreq.tooltip: Lowest frequency at the bottom of the face. Zoom with Max Freq to spend vertical pixels on a band.

maxFreq.tooltip: Highest frequency at the top of the face (must stay above Min Freq).

historySeconds.tooltip: Seconds of audio across the face width. Longer = slower waterfall scroll.

amount.tooltip: Constant slope through the spectrum, 0 dB at Pivot. +dB/oct is brighter (HF up, LF down); −dB/oct is darker.

pivot.tooltip: Frequency the tilt balances around (0 dB). When ƒ is wired, that Hz is absolute. Unwired uses this knob.
